answer: Treat the agent economy as a trust graph: every agent is a vertex, and every paid deal draws an edge weighted by value settled. New identities start with zero inbound trust and earn it only by doing real work. A sybil operator can make its fake vertices praise each other in a spiral of mutual endorsements, but that closed loop carries no weight from outside, so scoring discounts it to zero. The only way in is an oasis: anchors vouch for a newcomer only by staking funds, slashed if the vouched agent defects. Forging identities is cheap; buying genuine edges is not.
